title: Exclude fixed-paid rank-five singleton prefix banks
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

This exhausts the 14 owner-empty rank-five representatives explicitly left open by #7375. Seven are in the 712→127 cohort on pivot 1360 and seven are in 714→127 on pivot 1361. Every exterior prefix matrix has full column rank. Backward exact rational covectors and a separate forward sweep with explicit nonzero minors modulo 65537 agree on every bank and child-rank order. No pure endpoint prefix survives, so no suffix, pairing or literal candidate advances.

The hypothetical 2+3 split retains all 110,519 paid positions, adds 17 productive positions per target, and preserves rank surplus 1,424. The optimistic two-edit upper is about 0.415333013335182 raw. One extra paid rank-one position defeats the price. Zero savings were realized.

## Task and overlap

This refines the #7370 rank-five inventory on exact canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. #7375 tests the distinct 3→233 endpoint group and expressly leaves these 14 keys open. The scope is the two pinned singleton cohorts and the frozen static bank keys.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-rank-five-singleton-prefix-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay regenerates the price and both exact support receipts, verifies agreement, and rejects three altered dependencies. The historical chart-118 unit pairing supplies a positive control. The research commit adds one package and uses the existing two #7257 CI fixes for the historical selected replay gap documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7370 supplies inventory and #7375 its independently checked neighboring scope. #7382 supplies the opposite-direction row audit. #7334 and #7113 supply the exact word and caller, and #7298 the directed tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A changed prefix route or productive endpoint cohort needs a separately priced construction. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
